DECLARE
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_donor_decision_code VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_donor_decision_code_desc VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_unit_chk_digit VARCHAR2(5); -- Added by Edwin for ISBT128 03/13/2001

BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 IF :ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id != 'M' THEN
 :GLOBAL.validate_ff_value := 'DONOR'; 
 validate_unit_id_coexist(:ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id ,'S','*',temp_unit,temp_unit_chk_digit);
 check_package_failure;

 If :Global.code_scheme='I' then ---Added by Edwin 03.13.2001
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_unit||temp_unit_chk_digit;
 Else
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_unit;
 End if; 

 END IF;
 
EXCEPTION
 when others then
 :ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id := null;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := null; 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
END;

declare
 temp varchar2(5);
 no_days number;
 v_no_of_units number:=0;

begin 

 /* This validation was added by Edwin on 03.14.2001 for ISBT check*/
 IF :Global.code_scheme = 'I' then 
 If not CHECK_ISBT_PREFIX(substr(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id,1,5)) then 
 :ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id:=null;
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id','E');
 :ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id:=null;
 :ctrl_block_1.colldate:=null;
 previous_item;
 clear_item;
 show_error('16206');

 End if;

 if not number_check(substr(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id,6,8)) THEN
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id','E');
 :ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id:=null;
 previous_item;
 clear_item;
 show_error('16211');
 end if; 

 END IF;


 --set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id',DISPLAYED,property_false);
 --item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id','D');
 -- synchronize;
 --set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id',DISPLAYED,property_true);

 GET_FINAL_UNIT(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id,v_screen_unit_id);

 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id:=null;

 select nvl(count(*),0) into v_no_of_units from donations where 
 unit_id=v_screen_unit_id ;--and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id;

 if v_no_of_units=0 then
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id','E');
 :ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id:=null;
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id');
 clear_item;
 show_error('16022');
 elsif v_no_of_units=1 then
 select coll_date into :ctrl_block_1.colldate from donations where
 unit_id=v_screen_unit_id ;-- and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id;
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.colldate');
 do_key('next_item');
 else
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.colldate');
 end if;
 

end;

Item.Name: COLLDATE
Item.Hint: Enter collection date in 'MMDDYYYY' format.
Item.Label: Donor Id

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp Varchar2(5);
 test Varchar2(10);
 no_days Number;
 no_days1 Number;
 v_status Varchar2(10);
 prog_except Exception;
 v_screen_unit_id VARCHAR2(15);
 v_flag varchar2(1);
 chp_sysdate date;

BEGIN
 --
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 -- 
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 --pitss synchronize;

 /* Added by Edwin on 04-30-2001 */
 GET_FINAL_UNIT(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id,v_screen_unit_id);

 CHECK_UNIT_COLLDATE_MATCH(v_screen_unit_id,v_status);

 if v_status='FAIL' then
 raise prog_except;
 end if;

 test := to_char(:ctrl_block_1.colldate,'MMDDRR'); 

 Begin /* Check for record update */

 select to_number(parameter_value) into no_days 
 from valid_parameters
 where parameter_code = 'UPDTE_UNIT' and
 chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1);

 if (trunc(chp_sysdate) - :ctrl_block_1.colldate) > no_days then 
 clear_item;
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id','E');
 :ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id:=null;
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id');
 clear_item;
 show_error('16138',' '||to_char(no_days)||' days');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 Exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 End;

 SELECT drive_id into :ctrl_block_1.drive_id from donations WHERE 
 unit_id = v_screen_unit_id AND coll_date=:ctrl_block_1.colldate;
 -- AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;

 go_block('donations');
 set_block_property('donations',default_where,'unit_id = '||in_quotes(v_screen_unit_id)||' and coll_date = :ctrl_block_1.colldate');
 execute_query;
 -- go_item('donor_addresses.street_name'); 
 
 SELECT NVL (intl_addr_flag, 'N')
 INTO v_flag
 FROM donor_addresses da
 WHERE donor_id = :donations.donor_id ;
 
 if v_flag='N' then 
 go_item('donor_addresses.street_name'); 
 ElsIf V_FLAG='Y' Then
 go_item('donors.pb_intl_addr'); 
 End If;
 EXCEPTION 
 when no_data_found then
 clear_item;
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id','E');
 :ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id:=null;
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id');
 clear_item;
 show_error('16022');
 check_package_failure;
 when value_error then
 null;
 when prog_except then
 show_error('16157');
 check_package_failure; 
END;

declare

 --

 If temp <= 0 THEN

 status := populate_group( rg_id ); 
 the_rowcount := get_group_row_count(rg_id);
 if the_rowcount > 0 then
 list_values;
 else
 show_error('16052');
 check_package_failure;
 end If;
 else

 end if;
 end if;
 else

 end if;

end;

Item.Hint: Enter donation type or select from LISTVAL. [ Enter 99 if not present or wrong entry ]
Item.Label: Donation Type

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp varchar2(5);
 chp_sysdate date;
BEGIN
 --
 -- IM 512
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF;
 -- IM 512
 -- 
 Begin
 select nvl(inter_code,'***') into temp from VALID_REGINT_REASONS
 where inter_reason = 'NODONATION';
 if temp = '***' then
 next_item;
 else
 nullchk;check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 Exception
 when no_data_found then
 SHOW_ERROR('16065');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE; 
 End;

 IF temp != '***' THEN 
 If :donations.donation_type = '99' then
 place_donation_holds(temp);
 next_item;
 Else
 select 'temp' into temp from valid_donproc_codes A,valid_donation_types B
 where A.donation_type = :donations.donation_type and
 A.donation_type = B.donation_type and
 chp_sysdate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,chp_sysdate+1) AND 
 chp_sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,chp_sysdate+1) AND -- IM 512
 ROWNUM = 1;

 Begin
 select nvl(inter_code,'***') into temp 
 from VALID_REGINT_REASONS
 where inter_reason = 'NODONATION';
 
 If temp = '***' then
 next_item;
 Else
 REMOVE_HOLDS(TEMP);
 next_item;
 End if;
 Exception
 when no_data_found then
 SHOW_ERROR('16065');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE; 
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 End;
 End if;
 
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then
 SHOW_ERROR('18035');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE; 
 when too_many_rows then
 next_item;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
end;

Item.Name: DEFERRAL_REASON
Item.Hint: Enter deferral code, seperated by [,] if multiple or enter 0 if none.
Item.Label: Deferral Reason

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp VARCHAR2(5);
 cnt NUMBER;
 str_cnt NUMBER:= 1;
 def_pointer NUMBER:= 1;
 v_temp VARCHAR2(5);
 v_count number:=0;
 chp_sysdate date;
 Procedure remove_wrongly_placed is
 begin

 select nvl(inter_code,'***') into v_temp 
 from VALID_REGINT_REASONS
 where inter_reason = 'NODFREASON';

 if v_temp!='***' then 
 REMOVE_HOLDS(v_temp);
 end if;

 End remove_wrongly_placed;

BEGIN
 --
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 -- 
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;

 if substr(:donations.deferral_reason, NVL(length(:donations.deferral_reason), 0)) = ',' then
 SHOW_ERROR('16041');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE; 
 end if; 
--- added on 08/27/98 as no check after post audit

 IF :donations.deferral_reason != '0' then
 select nvl(count(*),0) into v_count from valid_hh_questions where --converted data check the question bank
 question_code=:donations.deferral_reason;
 IF v_count > 0 then --- > 2 
 next_item;
 ELSE
 if :donations.deferral_reason = '99' then
 place_donation_holds('NODEF');
 end if;
 If :donations.deferral_reason!= '99' then
 remove_wrongly_placed;
 if :donations.n_audit_flag is null then
 place_donation_holds('DRDEF');
 end if;
 End if;

 For cnt IN 1..99 loop
 
 if str_cnt > NVL(length(:donations.deferral_reason), 0) then
 exit;
 end if;
 
 def_pointer := INSTR(:donations.deferral_reason,',', def_pointer+1,1);
 If def_pointer = 0 then
 
 Begin
 select 'temp' into temp from health_history_template A, valid_master_codes B
 --valid_hh_questions C
 where ( ((A.donation_type = :donations.donation_type and
 A.sort_sequence = substr(:donations.deferral_reason,str_cnt) and
 :ctrl_block_1.drive_date between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,chp_sysdate+1)) OR
 (to_char(B.sort_sequence_3) = substr(:donations.deferral_reason,str_cnt)))
 and rownum = 1 and b.code_type = 'PHYCD' );-- OR
 --(c.question_code=substr(:donations.deferral_reason,str_cnt) and rownum=1 );
 
 str_cnt := str_cnt + 10;
 exit;
 End;
 Else
 
 select 'temp' into temp from health_history_template A, valid_master_codes B
 --valid_hh_questions C
 where ( ((A.donation_type = :donations.donation_type and
 A.sort_sequence= substr(:donations.deferral_reason,str_cnt,def_pointer-str_cnt)and
 :ctrl_block_1.drive_date between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,chp_sysdate+1)) OR
 (to_char(B.sort_sequence_3) = substr(:donations.deferral_reason,str_cnt,def_pointer-str_cnt))) 
 and rownum = 1 and b.code_type = 'PHYCD' ); --OR
 --(c.question_code=substr(:donations.deferral_reason,str_cnt,def_pointer-str_cnt) and rownum=1);

 str_cnt := def_pointer +1 ;
 End if; 
 End loop;
 next_item;
 END IF; ---> 2

 ELSE
 remove_wrongly_placed;

 remove_holds('DRDEF');
 remove_holds('NOTYP');
 :donations.deferral_type:=null;
 :donations.deferred_thru_date:=null;

 if :donations.deferred_thru_date is not null then
 go_item('donations.deferred_thru_date');
 else
 go_item('donations.screener_id');
 end if;

 END IF;

 


EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('16041');
 check_package_failure; 
 when others then
 handle_error;
END;

Item.Hint: Enter deferred through date in 'MMDDYYYY' format.
Item.Label: Procedure Code

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN

 IF :donations.deferred_thru_date is not null then

 /* Procedure navigate_next_item is

 End navigate_next_item;*/

 Procedure navigate_next_item is
 Begin
 If :donations.arm_used='B' then 
 next_item;
 Else
 If :donations.double_stick='N' then 
 go_item('donations.s_actual_rbc_loss');
 Else
 Next_Item;
 End if;
 End if; 
 End navigate_next_item;
BEGIN
 --
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 -- 
 IF :DONATIONS.BLEED_END_TIME_L IS not NULL then
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 begin
 select nvl(inter_code,'***') into temp from VALID_REGINT_REASONS
 where inter_reason = 'NOPHLEBO';
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 SHOW_ERROR('16065');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE; 
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 If :donations.bleed_end_phleb_L is not null then

 if :donations.bleed_end_phleb_L = '99' and temp != '***' then
 place_donation_holds(temp);
 navigate_next_item; --next_item;
 else

 select 'temp' into temp from EMPLOYEES where staff_no = :donations.bleed_end_phleb_L and
 :ctrl_block_1.drive_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1);

 begin
 select nvl(inter_code,'***') into temp from VALID_REGINT_REASONS
 where inter_reason = 'NOPHLEBO';
 
 if temp = '***' then
 navigate_next_item; --next_item;
 else
 
 IF CHECK_PHLEB_99 THEN
 REMOVE_HOLDS(TEMP);
 END IF;
 navigate_next_item; --next_item;
 end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 SHOW_ERROR('16065');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE; 
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 end if;
 else
 IF CHECK_PHLEB_99 THEN
 REMOVE_HOLDS(TEMP);
 END IF;
 navigate_next_item; ---next_item;
END IF;

EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('12006');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE; 
 when too_many_rows then
 navigate_next_item; --next_item;
 when others then
 handle_error;
END;

 temp varchar2(5);
 chp_sysdate date;
 Procedure navigate_next_item is
 Begin
 If :donations.double_stick='N' then 
 go_item('donations.s_actual_rbc_loss');
 Else
 Next_Item;
 End if; 
 End navigate_next_item;

BEGIN
 --
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 -- 
 if :DONATIONS.BLEED_END_TIME_R is not NULL then
 nullchk;check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 begin
 select nvl(inter_code,'***') into temp from VALID_REGINT_REASONS 
 where inter_reason = 'NOPHLEBO';
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 SHOW_ERROR('16065');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE; 
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 IF :donations.bleed_end_phleb_R is not null then

 if :donations.bleed_end_phleb_R = '99' and temp != '***' then
 place_donation_holds(temp);
 navigate_next_item; --next_item;
 else
 select 'temp' into temp from EMPLOYEES where staff_no = :donations.bleed_end_phleb_R and
 :ctrl_block_1.drive_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1);
 
 begin
 select nvl(inter_code,'***') into temp from VALID_REGINT_REASONS
 where inter_reason = 'NOPHLEBO';

 if temp = '***' then
 navigate_next_item; --next_item;
 else
 IF CHECK_PHLEB_99 THEN
 REMOVE_HOLDS(TEMP);
 END IF;
 navigate_next_item; --next_item;
 end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 SHOW_ERROR('16065');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE; 
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 end if;
 ELSE
 IF CHECK_PHLEB_99 THEN
 REMOVE_HOLDS(TEMP);
 END IF;
 navigate_next_item; --next_item;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('12006');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE; 
 when too_many_rows then
 navigate_next_item; ---next_item;
 when others then
 handle_error;
END;

bleed_start_time_KNI(:donations.bleed_start_time_R2, 'R2'); -- SCR 12040

/* -- SCR 12040
--/*******
--Modified and Verified for Y2K .....YPG .......06/23

declare
 drive_start_tm date;
 drive_start_time varchar2(18);
 bleed_start_time varchar2(18);
 v_allowed_drive_date varchar2(18);
 v_mid_night_crossing varchar2(2);
 v_temp_date varchar2(5);
 v_drive_length number;
 b_bleed_start_time date;
 err_txt VARCHAR2(300):= 'Bleed start time inconsistent with drive date - Should collection date be set forward/backward?'; 
 alert_id Alert; 
 alert_button Number; 
 d_drive_start_time number;
 d_bleed_start_time number;
BEGIN


IF :donations.bleed_start_time_R2 is not null then

 IF not(check_bleed_time(:donations.bleed_start_time_R2 )) then
 show_error('16068');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 

 if :donations.bleed_start_time_R1 is not null then
 if not(check_stick_time(:donations.bleed_start_time_R1,:donations.bleed_start_time_R2)) then
 show_error('16069');check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;


 --/******** Check the actual/scheduled start time if the drive ***************
 select nvl(actual_start_time,schedule_start_time)
 into drive_start_tm from drives where drive_id = :ctrl_block_1.drive_id;
 
 -- timezone conversion starts 
 IF is_timezone_enabled THEN
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, drive_start_tm, drive_start_tm);
 END IF;
 -- timezone conversion ends
 drive_start_time := to_char(drive_start_tm,'mm-dd-rr hh24:mi') ;
 v_drive_length:=8;

 bleed_start_time := to_char(:donations.bleed_start_time_R2,'HH24:mi');
 b_bleed_start_time:=to_date(to_char(:donations.b_start_date,'mm-dd-rr')||' '||bleed_start_time,'mm-dd-rr hh24:mi'); 
 bleed_start_time:=to_char(b_bleed_start_time,'mm-dd-rr hh24:mi');

 d_drive_start_time:=to_number(substr(drive_start_time,10,2)||'.'||substr(drive_start_time,13,2));
 d_bleed_start_time:=to_number(substr(bleed_start_time,10,2)||'.'||substr(bleed_start_time,13,2));

 --- message('Bleed St='||to_char(d_bleed_start_time));pause;
 
 if abs(d_drive_start_time - d_bleed_start_time) >= v_drive_length then
 alert_id := Find_Alert('YES_NO'); 
 Set_Alert_Property(alert_id, alert_message_text, err_txt ); 
 alert_button := Show_Alert( alert_id );
 IF alert_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN 
 if (:donations.b_start_date +1)>=sysdate then
 show_error('16166');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 :donations.b_start_date := :donations.b_start_date +1;
 :donations.b_end_date := :donations.b_start_date;
 next_item; 
 end if;

 END IF; 

 IF alert_button = ALERT_BUTTON2 THEN 
 :donations.b_start_date := :donations.b_start_date -1;
 :donations.b_end_date := :donations.b_start_date;
 next_item; 
 END IF; 


 IF alert_button = ALERT_BUTTON3 THEN 
 next_item;
 END IF; 
 else

 :donations.b_start_date := :ctrl_block_1.drive_date;
 :donations.b_end_date := :donations.b_start_date;
 next_item;
 end if;
ELSE
 :donations.b_end_date := :donations.b_start_date;
 next_item;
END IF;

exception
 when value_error then
 message('value error');pause; 
 when others then
 message(sqlerrm);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
END;
*/

DECLARE
 v_string varchar2(30);
 v_veni varchar2(50);
 v_start_pos number:=0;
 v_no_of_pos number:=0;
 v_comma varchar2(2);
 v_comma_pos number:=0;

 v_row_count NUMBER:=0;
 rg_name VARCHAR2(5) := 'VENI'; 
 rg_col VARCHAR2(10) := rg_name||'.VCODE'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 gc_id GroupColumn; 
 chp_sysdate date;
 
 Procedure veni_check(pl_veni in varchar2) is
 v_temp number;
 Begin
 select nvl(count(*),0) into v_temp from valid_attributes_don where attrib_group='VENI' and
 attrib_code=pl_veni and chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1);
 if v_temp=0 then
 SHOW_ERROR('16012');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE; 
 end if;
 End veni_check; 
 
 
BEGIN
 --
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 -- 
 rg_id := Find_Group( rg_name ); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 Delete_Group_Row( rg_id, ALL_ROWS ); 
 END IF;

 IF :donations.s_venipuncture is null then
 next_item;
 ELSE

 v_string:=:donations.s_venipuncture||'*';
 v_start_pos:=v_start_pos+1;
 
 Loop
 
 v_no_of_pos:=v_no_of_pos+1;
 
 v_comma:=substr(v_string,v_no_of_pos,1);
 
 v_comma_pos:=v_comma_pos+1;
 
 if v_comma=',' then
 v_veni:=substr(v_string,v_start_pos,v_comma_pos-1);
 veni_check(v_veni);
 check_for_duplicate_veni(v_veni); 
 v_row_count:=v_row_count+1; 
 Add_Group_Row( rg_id, END_OF_GROUP ); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col, v_row_count,v_veni); 
 
 v_start_pos:=v_no_of_pos+1;
 v_comma_pos:=0;
 end if;


 if v_comma='*' then
 v_veni:=substr(v_string,v_start_pos,v_comma_pos-1);
 veni_check(v_veni);
 check_for_duplicate_veni(v_veni); 
 v_row_count:=v_row_count+1;
 Add_Group_Row( rg_id, END_OF_GROUP ); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col, v_row_count,v_veni); 

 exit;
 end if;

 End loop;
 next_item;
END IF;

EXCEPTION when others then
 message(sqlerrm);
 check_package_failure;
END;

/* ************ Modified this trigger to incorporate either isbt or codabar depending upon

 ******************************************************************************************** */

DECLARE
 temp varchar2(5);
 temp_unit number;
 no_days number; 
 v_screen_unit_id varchar2(15);
 chp_sysdate date;
BEGIN 
 --
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 -- 
 item_change('donations.s_pass_unit_id','E');
 :donations.s_void_unit_id := null;
 item_change('donations.s_void_unit_id','D');

 --:donations.unit_id:=null;
 :donations.s_pass_unit_id:=null;

 begin
 select to_number(parameter_value) into no_days from valid_parameters
 where parameter_code = 'UNIT' and chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1); 
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 
 IF :donations.void_unit_id is not null then

 If :donations.void_unit_id = nvl(:global.void_unit_id,' ') then -- if void unit exists already (declared in the post-query of donations)
 next_item;
 Else

 if (nvl(length(:donations.void_unit_id), 0) != nvl(length(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id), 0)) then
 show_error('0049');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;

 IF Length(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id)=15 then --if initial unit id is isbt
 v_screen_unit_id := substr(:donations.void_unit_id,1,13);
 
 if not CHECK_ISBT_PREFIX(substr(:donations.void_unit_id,1,5)) then 
 clear_item;
 show_error('16206');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 end if;
 
 if not number_check(substr(:donations.void_unit_id,6,8)) THEN
 clear_item;
 show_error('16211');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 end if;
 ELSE -- If codabar

 v_screen_unit_id := :donations.void_unit_id;

 if length(:donations.void_unit_id)!=7 then
 show_error('0049');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 
 if :GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme ='N' then
 if not number_check(:donations.void_unit_id) then
 show_error('0220');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;


 -- If codabar first entry is correct ask for the second entry

 If :global.double_check is null then
 :global.double_check:= :donations.void_unit_id;
 clear_item;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 Else
 if Length(:global.double_check)!= Length(:donations.void_unit_id) then
 :global.double_check:=null;
 show_error('0049');
 check_package_failure;
 end if; 
 
 if :global.double_check!=:donations.void_unit_id then
 :global.double_check:=null;
 show_error('0045');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 End if;

 END IF; --isbt or codabar

 End if;
 
 validate_void_unit(:donations.void_unit_id); 

 If :donations.void_unit_id!=nvl(:global.void_unit_id,' ') then -- declared in the post-query of donations
 
 select 'temp' into temp /*check if entered already */
 from donations
 where (unit_id = v_screen_unit_id or void_unit_id=v_screen_unit_id) and
 coll_date between trunc(chp_sysdate) - no_days and trunc(chp_sysdate) ;--and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ; Comment by ash

 show_error('16005');
 check_package_failure;
 Else
 go_item('donations.s_pass_unit_id');
 End if;

 ELSE
 if :global.double_check is not null then
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 check_coll_date;
 END IF;

 go_item('donations.s_pass_unit_id');
 
EXCEPTION 
 when no_data_found then
 if :donations.void_unit_id = :ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id then
 show_error('16005');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 check_coll_date;
 go_item('donations.s_pass_unit_id');
 end if;
 when too_many_rows then
 show_error('16005');
 clear_item;
 previous_item;
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;

END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
/****************************************************************************************
* if the unit does not match with the unit id entered at the begining clear the blocks
* and start all over again. 
* if ok check the eligibility of the donor again. 
* 
* Modified on 05/12/2011; AV; International addr check; employer addr check; create new employer ID logic;
*****************************************************************************************/
DECLARE
 remove_except exception;
 place_except exception;
 v_out varchar2(200);
 v_code varchar2(20);
 v_count number;
 v_screen_unit_id varchar2(15);
 szError VARCHAR2(450);
 alert_id number;
 emp_id VARCHAR2(10);
 l_cnt NUMBER; -- IM 10387
BEGIN

 nullchk;check_package_failure;
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id','E');
 

 /*
 -- Added on 05/12/2011;AV
 IF :donor_addresses.employer_name IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF NVL(:donor_addresses.s_emp_intl_flag,'N')= 'Y' then 
 IF ( :donor_addresses.emp_intl_city IS NULL
 -- OR :donor_addresses.emp_intl_state IS NULL
 -- OR :donor_addresses.emp_intl_postal IS NULL
 OR :donor_addresses.emp_intl_country IS NULL 
 ) THEN 
 go_item('donor_addresses.emp_intl_city');
 show_error('0080 ' || ' : International Address');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF (:donor_addresses.e_city IS NULL 
 OR :donor_addresses.e_zip IS NULL
 ) THEN 
 GO_ITEM ('donor_addresses.employer_name');
 show_error('0080', ' : City or Zip ');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 END IF;
 END IF; 
 ------
 */
 

 --set_item_property('donations.s_pass_unit_id',DISPLAYED,property_false);
 --synchronize;
 --set_item_property('donations.s_pass_unit_id',DISPLAYED,property_true);


 GET_FINAL_UNIT(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id,v_screen_unit_id);
 :donations.unit_id:=v_screen_unit_id;
 --pitss synchronize;

 synchronize;
 IF :donations.f_pass_unit_id!= :ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id then
 
 begin
 select error into szError from valid_errors where error_code='16015';
 exception when others then
 message('No error description for:16015',no_acknowledge);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end; 
 
 set_alert_property('error_alert',alert_message_text,'Err:'||'16015: '||szError);
 alert_id:=show_alert('error_alert');
 
 item_change('donations.s_pass_unit_id','E');
 go_item('donations.s_pass_unit_id');
 :donations.s_pass_unit_id:=null;
 :donations.f_pass_unit_id:=null;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id:=null;
 --pitss synchronize;
 clear_form(no_validate);
 initialise_windows;
 --SHOW_ERROR('16015');
 --CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE; 
 ELSE
 
 update_all_tables(v_screen_unit_id);

 /* If :donations.deferral_reason not in('0','99') then
 if :donations.n_audit_flag is null then
 place_DONATION_holds('DRDEF');
 end if;
 End if; */ 

 
 -- IM 10109; copied from driregis screen.
 IF :donations.donation_type NOT IN ('AU', 'TH') THEN
 donor_eligibility (v_screen_unit_id); /* call eligibility_check only if donor is selected*/
 END IF;
 ----------- 

 v_out:=null;
 If :donations.deferral_reason not in ('0','99') 
 and :donations.donor_id is not null then
 if :donations.n_audit_flag is null then
 place_donor_holds(:donations.donor_id,'DRDEF',null,v_out); /***** donor with deferral ****/
 if v_out!='OK' then
 raise place_except;
 end if;
 end if; 
 End if;

 v_out:=null;

 If :donations.deferral_reason='99' and :donations.donor_id is not null then 
 if :donations.n_audit_flag is null then
 place_donor_holds(:donations.donor_id,'NODEF',null,v_out);
 if v_out !='OK' then
 raise place_except;
 end if;
 end if;
 End if;


 /* ------Remove holds ----------- */

 v_out:=null;

 IF :donations.deferral_reason = '0' and :global.remove_inter='Y' then
 if :global.remove_code ='DRDEF' then
 v_code:='DRDEF';
 else
 v_code:='NODEF';
 end if;

 Begin

 select nvl(count(*),0) into v_count from donation_interdictions where
 unit_id = v_screen_unit_id and coll_date = :ctrl_block_1.colldate and
 transaction_id = :donations.transaction_id and inter_code=v_code and
 release_date is null;
 
 if v_count > 0 then
 remove_donation_holds(v_screen_unit_id,:ctrl_block_1.colldate,
 :donations.transaction_id,v_code,v_out);
 
 if v_out!='OK' then 
 raise remove_except;
 end if;
 end if;
 End;

 Begin
 v_out:=null;
 If :donations.donor_id is not null then 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into v_count from donor_interdictions where
 donor_id = :donations.donor_id and 
 transaction_id = :donations.transaction_id and 
 inter_code=v_code and term_date is null;
 
 if v_count > 0 then
 remove_donor_holds(:donations.donor_id,:donations.transaction_id,v_code,v_out);
 if v_out!='OK' then 
 raise remove_except;
 end if;
 end if;
 End if;
 End;


 END IF;
 
 /*---------check the hold status----------*/
 update_ddi_ddt; --- Added on 01/27/99 by Edwin
 check_hold_status;
 
 :System.Message_Level := '10'; 
 commit_form;
 update_donation_interdictions(v_screen_unit_id);
 commit_form;
 :System.Message_Level := '0'; 
 If form_success then
 -- IM 10387
 begin
 select COUNT(*) into l_cnt 
 from donation_interdictions
 where unit_id = v_screen_unit_id 
 and coll_date = :ctrl_block_1.colldate
 and release_date is null;
 if l_cnt = 0 then
 :global.action := '';
 else
 :global.action := 'HOLD';
 end if;
 end; 
 -- 
 If (:global.action = 'HOLD') then /*** if donation on HOLD then Message for operater*/
 show_error('16098',:donations.transaction_id);
 item_change('donations.s_pass_unit_id','E');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id','E');
 :donations.s_pass_unit_id:=null;
 :donations.f_pass_unit_id:=null;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id:=null;
 clear_form(no_validate);
 initialise_windows;
 --show_error('16098',:donations.transaction_id);
 check_package_failure;
 Else 
 show_error('16154'); 
 item_change('donations.s_pass_unit_id','E');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id','E');
 :donations.s_pass_unit_id:=null;
 :donations.f_pass_unit_id:=null;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id:=null;
 clear_form(no_validate);
 initialise_windows;
 --show_error('16154');
 check_package_failure;
 End if; 
 End if;

 END IF;
 
EXCEPTION 
 WHEN remove_except then
 item_change('donations.s_pass_unit_id','E');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id','E');
 :donations.s_pass_unit_id:=null;
 :donations.f_pass_unit_id:=null;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id:=null;
 clear_form(no_validate);
 show_error('16112');
 check_package_failure;

 WHEN place_except then
 item_change('donations.s_pass_unit_id','E');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id','E');
 :donations.s_pass_unit_id:=null;
 :donations.f_pass_unit_id:=null;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id:=null;
 clear_form(no_validate);
 show_error('16113');
 check_package_failure;

 WHEN others then
 item_change('donations.s_pass_unit_id','E');
 :donations.s_pass_unit_id:=null;
 :donations.f_pass_unit_id:=null;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id:=null;
 message(sqlerrm);
 check_package_failure;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-CHECK-DELETE-MASTER
Trigger.TriggerText:
--
-- Begin default relation declare section
--
DECLARE
 Dummy_Define VARCHAR2(1);
 --
 -- Begin DONORS detail declare section
 --
 CURSOR DONORS_cur IS 
 SELECT 1 FROM DONORS 
 WHERE DONOR_ID = :DONATIONS.DONOR_ID;
 --
 -- End DONORS detail declare section
 --
 --
 -- Begin DONATION_INTERDICTIONS detail declare section
 --
 CURSOR DONATION_INTERDICTIONS_cur IS 
 SELECT 1 FROM DONATION_INTERDICTIONS 
 WHERE TRANSACTION_ID = :DONATIONS.TRANSACTION_ID;
 --
 -- End DONATION_INTERDICTIONS detail declare section
 --
--
-- End default relation declare section
--
--
-- Begin default relation program section
--
BEGIN
 --
 -- Begin DONORS detail program section
 --
 OPEN DONORS_cur; 
 FETCH DONORS_cur INTO Dummy_Define; 
 IF ( DONORS_cur%found ) THEN 
 Message('Cannot delete master record when matching detail records exist.'); 
 CLOSE DONORS_cur; 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;
 CLOSE DONORS_cur;
 --
 -- End DONORS detail program section
 --
 --
 -- Begin DONATION_INTERDICTIONS detail program section
 --
 OPEN DONATION_INTERDICTIONS_cur; 
 FETCH DONATION_INTERDICTIONS_cur INTO Dummy_Define; 
 IF ( DONATION_INTERDICTIONS_cur%found ) THEN 
 Message('Cannot delete master record when matching detail records exist.'); 
 CLOSE DONATION_INTERDICTIONS_cur; 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;
 CLOSE DONATION_INTERDICTIONS_cur;
 --
 -- End DONATION_INTERDICTIONS detail program section
 --
END;
--
-- End default relation program section
--

Trigger.Name: ON-POPULATE-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
--
-- Begin default relation declare section
--
DECLARE
 recstat VARCHAR2(20) := :System.record_status; 
 startitm VARCHAR2(61) := :System.cursor_item; 
 rel_id Relation;
--
-- End default relation declare section
--
--
-- Begin default relation program section
--
BEGIN
 IF ( recstat = 'NEW' or recstat = 'INSERT' ) THEN 
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 --
 -- Begin DONORS detail program section
 --
 IF ( (:DONATIONS.DONOR_ID is not null) ) THEN 
 rel_id := Find_Relation('DONATIONS.RELATION218'); 
 Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'DONORS'); 
 END IF;
 --
 -- End DONORS detail program section
 --
 --
 -- Begin DONATION_INTERDICTIONS detail program section
 --
 IF ( (:DONATIONS.TRANSACTION_ID is not null) ) THEN 
 rel_id := Find_Relation('DONATIONS.RELATION226'); 
 Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'DONATION_INTERDICTIONS'); 
 END IF;
 --
 -- End DONATION_INTERDICTIONS detail program section
 --

 IF ( :System.cursor_item <> startitm ) THEN 
 Go_Item(startitm); 
 Check_Package_Failure; 
 END IF;
END;
--
-- End default relation program section
--

DECLARE
 s_veni varchar2(40);
 s_reaction varchar2(40);
 szChkDgt varchar2(5);
BEGIN

 :donations.s_coll_date := :donations.coll_date;
 :donations.b_start_date := :donations.coll_date;
 :donations.b_end_date := :donations.coll_date;

 :donations.s_actual_rbc_loss := :donations.actual_rbc_loss;
 :donations.s_actual_plasma_loss := :donations.actual_plasma_loss;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id:= :donations.void_unit_id;

 :ctrl_block_1.set_id := :donations.set_id ;
 :global.void_unit_id:=:donations.void_unit_id;

-- :donations.unit_id := '';
 :ctrl_block_1.drive_id := :donations.drive_id;

 :global.deferral_type:=:donations.deferral_type;
 :global.dftd:=:donations.deferred_thru_date;

 IF :donations.void_unit_id is not null then 
 if Length(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id)=15 then 
 VALIDATE_UNIT_CHKDIGIT(:donations.void_unit_id,szChkDgt);
 :donations.void_unit_id:=:donations.void_unit_id||ltrim(szChkDgt);
 :global.void_unit_id:=:donations.void_unit_id;
 else
 :global.void_unit_id:=:donations.void_unit_id;
 end if;
 End if;

 select drive_date,location_id into :ctrl_block_1.drive_date,:ctrl_block_1.s_location_id
 from drives where drive_id = :donations.drive_id; 

 begin
 select USER_FIRST_NAME || ' ' || USER_LAST_NAME 
 into :ctrl_block_1.entered_by from system_users
 where user_id = :donations.insert_user;
 exception 
 when no_data_found then
 :ctrl_block_1.entered_by:='Unknown';
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;


 if :donations.arm_used = 'O' then
 :donations.other_bleed_s_time := to_date(to_char(:donations.bleed_start_time_L1,'hh24:mi'),'hh24:mi') ;
 :donations.other_s_phleb := :donations.bleed_start_phleb_L1 ;
 :donations.other_bleed_E_time := to_date(to_char(:donations.bleed_end_time_L,'hh24:mi'),'hh24:mi') ;
 :donations.other_E_phleb := :donations.bleed_end_phleb_L ;
 :donations.bleed_start_time_L1 := '';
 :donations.bleed_start_phleb_L1 := '';
 :donations.bleed_end_time_L := '';
 :donations.bleed_end_phleb_L := '';
 end if;

 pull_up_veni(:donations.transaction_id,s_veni);
 :donations.s_venipuncture:=s_veni;
 :GLOBAL.s_venipuncture:=s_veni; -- This global variable is used in the update_all_table procedure. 10.01.01

 pull_up_reaction(:donations.transaction_id,s_reaction);
 :donations.s_rections:=s_reaction;
 check_for_audit;
 check_for_def_reason;

 If :donations.deferral_reason!='0' then
 :global.remove_inter:='Y';
 if :donations.deferral_reason='99' then
 :global.remove_code:='NODEF';
 else
 :global.remove_code:='DRDEF';
 end if;
 Else
 :global.remove_inter:='N';
 End if;

 
 if :donations.donor_id is null then
 set_item_property('donations.deferral_type',enabled,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 else
 set_item_property('donations.deferral_type',enabled,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('donations.deferral_type',navigable,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 end if;

 
EXCEPTION
 when others then
 message(sqlerrm);
 check_package_failure;
END;


/**************************************************************************************
Decided to disable update completly on these fields on 01 - 12 - 13
by Edwin , Janet and cindy
if :donations.N_Audit_Flag is not null then
 set_item_property('donations.donation_type',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('donations.procedure_code',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
else
 set_item_property('donations.donation_type',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('donations.procedure_code',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
end if;

Trigger.Name: PRE-UPDATE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 chp_sysdate date;
BEGIN
 --
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 -- 

:donations.program_id := :banner.prog_name;
:donations.chapter_id := :global.chapter_id;

:donations.actual_rbc_loss:=To_number(:donations.s_actual_rbc_loss);
:donations.actual_plasma_loss:=to_number(:donations.s_actual_plasma_loss);

if Length(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id)=15 then 
 :donations.void_unit_id := substr(:donations.void_unit_id,1,13);
End if;

If :donations.drive_id!=:ctrl_block_1.drive_id then --PR# 001.031152 :Edwin
 :donations.drive_id:=:ctrl_block_1.drive_id;
End if; 

/* This code is added by Edwin to update the 'other' fields to Left arm fields as the same field is used */
 begin
 select nvl(credit_count,0) into :donations.credit_count from 
 valid_proc_codes where procedure_code=:donations.procedure_code
 and :donations.coll_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1);
 exception when no_data_found then 
 :donations.credit_count:=1;
 when others then handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --The following is addedd for PR#001.031551----------------- 
 
 IF :donations.bleed_start_time_L1 IS NOT NULL THEN
 :donations.bleed_start_time_L1 := 
 TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(:B_START_DATE,'MM-DD-YYYY')||' '||TO_CHAR(:donations.bleed_start_time_L1,'HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-YYYY HH24:MI');
 -- timezone conversion starts
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,:donations.bleed_start_time_L1, :donations.bleed_start_time_L1);
 end if;
 -- timezone conversion ends

Trigger.Name: ON-CHECK-DELETE-MASTER
Trigger.TriggerText:
--
-- Begin default relation declare section
--
DECLARE
 Dummy_Define VARCHAR2(1);
 --
 -- Begin DONOR_ADDRESSES detail declare section
 --
 CURSOR DONOR_ADDRESSES_cur IS 
 SELECT 1 FROM DONOR_ADDRESSES 
 WHERE DONOR_ID = :DONORS.DONOR_ID;
 --
 -- End DONOR_ADDRESSES detail declare section
 --
--
-- End default relation declare section
--
--
-- Begin default relation program section
--
BEGIN
 --
 -- Begin DONOR_ADDRESSES detail program section
 --
 OPEN DONOR_ADDRESSES_cur; 
 FETCH DONOR_ADDRESSES_cur INTO Dummy_Define; 
 IF ( DONOR_ADDRESSES_cur%found ) THEN 
 Message('Cannot delete master record when matching detail records exist.'); 
 CLOSE DONOR_ADDRESSES_cur; 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;
 CLOSE DONOR_ADDRESSES_cur;
 --
 -- End DONOR_ADDRESSES detail program section
 --
END;
--
-- End default relation program section
--

Trigger.Name: ON-POPULATE-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
--
-- Begin default relation declare section
--
DECLARE
 recstat VARCHAR2(20) := :System.record_status; 
 startitm VARCHAR2(61) := :System.cursor_item; 
 rel_id Relation;
--
-- End default relation declare section
--
--
-- Begin default relation program section
--
BEGIN
 IF ( recstat = 'NEW' or recstat = 'INSERT' ) THEN 
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 --
 -- Begin DONOR_ADDRESSES detail program section
 --
 IF ( (:DONORS.DONOR_ID is not null) ) THEN 
 rel_id := Find_Relation('DONORS.R_DONOR_ADDRESSES'); 
 Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'DONOR_ADDRESSES'); 
 END IF;
 --
 -- End DONOR_ADDRESSES detail program section
 --

 IF ( :System.cursor_item <> startitm ) THEN 
 Go_Item(startitm); 
 Check_Package_Failure; 
 END IF;
END;
--
-- End default relation program section
--

DECLARE
 szSCAN_ID varchar2(20);
 szError varchar2(10);
 nCount NUMBER:=0;
BEGIN
IF :donor_addresses.scan_id is not null then

 IF Length(:donor_addresses.scan_id)!=13 then
 :donor_addresses.scan_id:=null;
 show_error('21085');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 VALIDATE_DONOR_SCAN_ID('*'||:donor_addresses.scan_id||'*',:GLOBAL.BC_SCAN_ID,szError,szSCAN_ID);
 If szError!='NO' then
 :donor_addresses.scan_id:=null;
 show_error(szError);
 check_package_failure;
 Else 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nCount from donors where scan_id=:donor_addresses.scan_id and 
 donor_id!=:donors.donor_id;
 If nCount > 0 then
 show_error('21100');
 check_package_failure;
 Else
 :donor_addresses.scan_id:=szSCAN_ID;
 go_item('donor_addresses.employer_name');
 End If;
 End If;
 END IF;
ELSE
 go_item('donor_addresses.employer_name');
END IF;

END;

DECLARE
 temp VARCHAR2 (5);
 err_txt VARCHAR2 (300) := 'Do you want to create new employer?';
 alert_id alert;
 alert_button NUMBER;
 a_value_chosen BOOLEAN;
 intl_count NUMBER;
 chp_sysdate date;
 ------------------------------------------------------------
 procedure populate_emp_addr IS
 t_intl_flag VARCHAR2(1);
 BEGIN
 select decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N'), 'Y', intl_postal_code, null),
 decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N'), 'Y', intl_city, null),
 decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N'), 'Y', intl_state, null),
 decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N'), 'Y', intl_country_name, null),
 nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N') 
 into :donor_addresses.emp_intl_postal,
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_city,
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_state,
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_postal,
 t_intl_flag
 from donor_employers
 where employer_id = :donors.employer_id;
 
 if t_intL_flag = 'N' then 
 select zip, city, state into :DONOR_ADDRESSES.E_ZIP, :DONOR_ADDRESSES.E_CITY, :DONOR_ADDRESSES.E_STATE
 from valid_city_state where usps_id = :donor_addresses.e_usps_id;
 item_change('donor_addresses.pb_emp_intl_addr','D');
 GO_ITEM ('donor_addresses.ethnic_group');
 else
 item_change('donor_addresses.pb_emp_intl_addr','E');
 go_item('donor_addreses.pb_emp_intl_addr');
 end if;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN too_many_rows then message('Duplicate emmployer IDs in the system CONTACT IS!!!!!');
 WHEN others then handle_error; check_package_failure;
 END populate_emp_addr;
 ---------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
 --
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 -- 
 IF :donor_addresses.employer_name IS NULL THEN
 :donors.employer_id := NULL;
 -- go_item('donations.donation_type');
 GO_ITEM ('donor_addresses.ethnic_group');
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 DEFAULT_VALUE ('NO', 'global.new_emp');
 IF :GLOBAL.new_emp = 'YES' THEN
 --GO_ITEM ('donor_addresses.e_city');
 -- IM:7323; 04/26/2012;
 :donors.employer_id := NULL; 
 :donor_addresses.e_city := NULL;
 :donor_addresses.e_state := NULL;
 :donor_addresses.e_zip := NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_city:= NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_state:= NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_postal:= NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_country:= NULL; 
 :donor_addresses.s_emp_intl_flag := 'N'; 
 item_change('donor_addresses.e_zip','E'); -- Disabled if employer with international address is already attached to donor.
 ------------------------ 
 item_change('donor_addresses.pb_emp_intl_addr','E');
 go_item('donor_addresses.pb_emp_intl_addr');
 ELSE
 IF :donors.employer_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 select count(*) into intl_count from donor_employers 
 where employer_id = :donors.employer_id and nvl(intl_addr_flag, 'N') = 'Y';

 If intl_Count = 0 then --- local employer; 
 select a.employer_id, b.zip, b.city, b.state,a.usps_id 
 into :donor_addresses.employer_id,:donor_addresses.e_zip,:donor_addresses.e_city,
 :donor_addresses.e_state,:donor_addresses.e_usps_id
 from donor_employers a, valid_city_state b 
 where a.employer_id=:donors.employer_id and
 a.employer_name = :donor_addresses.employer_name and
 a.usps_id = b.usps_id and chp_sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,chp_sysdate+1);
 
 item_change('donor_addresses.pb_emp_intl_addr','D');
 go_item('donor_addresses.ethnic_group');
 Else
 select a.employer_id, a.intl_city, a.intl_state, 
 a.intl_postal_code, intl_country_name 
 into :donor_addresses.employer_id,:donor_addresses.emp_intl_city,:donor_addresses.emp_intl_state,
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_postal, :donor_addresses.emp_intl_country -- IM:7323.
 from donor_employers a
 where a.employer_id=:donors.employer_id and
 a.employer_name = :donor_addresses.employer_name and chp_sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,chp_sysdate+1);
 
 item_change('donor_addresses.pb_emp_intl_addr','E');
 go_item('donor_addresses.pb_emp_intl_addr');
 End if; 
 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 BEGIN
 a_value_chosen := SHOW_LOV ('LOV_Employers');

 IF NOT a_value_chosen THEN
 alert_id := FIND_ALERT ('YES_OR_NO');
 SET_ALERT_PROPERTY (alert_id,alert_message_text,err_txt);
 alert_button := SHOW_ALERT (alert_id);
 IF alert_button = alert_button1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.new_emp := 'YES';
 END IF;
 IF alert_button = alert_button2 THEN
 :GLOBAL.new_emp := 'NO';
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF a_value_chosen THEN
 populate_emp_addr; -- Added on 05/15/2011; AV; populates empl address and move the cursor to next item;
 END IF;
 END;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
 MESSAGE('Duplicate employer IDs in the system CONTACT IS!!!!');
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 ELSE -- donors.employer_id is null;
 select count(*) into intl_count from donor_employers where employer_name = :donor_addresses.employer_name and nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N')= 'Y';
 
 if intl_count <> 0 then -- international employer; 
 IF :donor_addresses.employer_name IS NOT NULL THEN
 select a.employer_id, a.intl_city, a.intl_state, 
 a.intl_postal_code, intl_country_name 
 into :donor_addresses.employer_id,:donor_addresses.emp_intl_city,:donor_addresses.emp_intl_state,
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_postal, :donor_addresses.emp_intl_country
 from donor_employers a
 where a.employer_name=:donor_addresses.employer_name
 and chp_sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,chp_sysdate+1); 
 :donors.employer_id := :donor_addresses.employer_id;
 item_change('donor_addresses.pb_emp_intl_addr','E');
 GO_ITEM ('donor_addresses.pb_emp_intl_addr');
 ELSE
 GO_ITEM ('donor_addresses.ethnic_group'); 
 IF :GLOBAL.new_emp = 'YES' THEN
 -- If the newly created employer id needs to be deleted
 :donors.employer_id := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.new_emp := 'NO';
 END IF;
 
 :donor_addresses.e_city := NULL;
 :donor_addresses.e_state := NULL;
 :donor_addresses.e_zip := NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_city:= NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_state:= NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_postal:= NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_country:= NULL; 
 END IF;
 else ----- local employer
 If :donor_addresses.employer_name is not null then
 select a.employer_id, b.zip, b.city, b.state,a.usps_id into 
 :donor_addresses.employer_id,:donor_addresses.e_zip,:donor_addresses.e_city,
 :donor_addresses.e_state,:donor_addresses.e_usps_id
 from donor_employers a, valid_city_state b 
 where a.employer_name = :donor_addresses.employer_name and
 a.usps_id = b.usps_id and chp_sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,chp_sysdate+1);
 
 :donors.employer_id := :donor_addresses.employer_id;
 GO_ITEM ('donor_addresses.ethnic_group');
 Else
 GO_ITEM ('donor_addresses.ethnic_group'); 
 if :global.new_emp='YES' then --If the newly created employer id needs to be deleted 
 :donors.employer_id:=null; 
 :global.new_emp:='NO';
 end if;
 :donor_addresses.e_city:=null;
 :donor_addresses.e_state:=null;
 :donor_addresses.e_zip:=null;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_city:= NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_state:= NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_postal:= NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_country:= NULL; 
 End if;
 end if; -- international, local check; 
 END IF; -- donors.employer_id or donor_addresses.employer_name
 END IF; -- Globa.new_emp YES OR NO
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'temp'
 INTO temp
 FROM donor_employers
 WHERE employer_name LIKE :donor_addresses.employer_name || '%'
 AND chp_SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL (term_date,
 chp_SYSDATE + 1);

 a_value_chosen := SHOW_LOV ('LOV_Employers');

 IF NOT a_value_chosen THEN
 alert_id := FIND_ALERT ('YES_OR_NO');
 SET_ALERT_PROPERTY (alert_id, alert_message_text, err_txt);
 alert_button := SHOW_ALERT (alert_id);

 IF alert_button = alert_button1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.new_emp := 'YES';
 END IF;

 IF alert_button = alert_button2 THEN
 :GLOBAL.new_emp := 'NO';
 END IF;
 ELSE
 populate_emp_addr; -- Added on 05/15/2011; AV; populates empl address and move the cursor to next item;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 alert_id := FIND_ALERT ('YES_OR_NO');
 err_txt :=
 'No match found. Do you want to create new employer?';
 SET_ALERT_PROPERTY (alert_id, alert_message_text, err_txt);
 alert_button := SHOW_ALERT (alert_id);

 IF alert_button = alert_button1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.new_emp := 'YES';
 END IF;

 IF alert_button = alert_button2 THEN
 :GLOBAL.new_emp := 'NO';
 END IF;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
 a_value_chosen := SHOW_LOV ('LOV_Employers');

 IF NOT a_value_chosen THEN
 alert_id := FIND_ALERT ('YES_OR_NO');
 SET_ALERT_PROPERTY (alert_id,
 alert_message_text,
 err_txt
 );
 alert_button := SHOW_ALERT (alert_id);

 IF alert_button = alert_button1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.new_emp := 'YES';
 END IF;

 IF alert_button = alert_button2 THEN
 :GLOBAL.new_emp := 'NO';
 END IF;
 ELSE
 populate_emp_addr; -- Added on 05/15/2011; AV; populates empl address and move the cursor to next item;
 END IF;
 END;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
 a_value_chosen := SHOW_LOV ('LOV_Employers');

 IF a_value_chosen THEN
 populate_emp_addr; -- Added on 05/15/2011; AV; populates empl address and move the cursor to next item;
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

 if :donors.employer_id is not null then
 select count(*) into intl_count from donor_employers where employer_id = :donors.employer_id

 BEGIN

 --item_change('donor_addresses.e_city','D');

 :donor_addresses.s_emp_intl_flag := 'Y';
 select employer_name, intl_city, intl_state, intl_postal_code, intl_country_name

 where employer_id = :donors.employer_id;
 :donor_addresses.e_city := null;

 :donor_addresses.e_zip := null;

 --item_change('donor_addresses.e_city','E');

 :donor_addresses.s_emp_intl_flag := 'N';
 select A.Employer_name,b.zip,b.city,b.state,b.usps_id into :donor_addresses.Employer_name,
 :donor_addresses.e_zip,:donor_addresses.e_city,:donor_addresses.e_state,:donor_addresses.e_usps_id

 null;

 handle_error;

 end if; 
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

PROCEDURE update_all_tables(szUnitId in varchar2) IS
 emp_id varchar2(10);
 str_cnt number := 1;
 dnr_id varchar2(10);
 nReact NUMBER:=0;
BEGIN

 If :ctrl_block_1.colldate!=:donations.coll_date then

 Begin
 
 update donation_interdictions set coll_date =:donations.coll_date 
 where unit_id =szUnitId and coll_date= :ctrl_block_1.colldate;
 
 update MERGE_HOLD_UNITS set coll_date = :donations.coll_date
 where unit_id = szUnitId and coll_date =:ctrl_block_1.colldate;

 update RESULT_HOLDING_AREA set coll_date = :donations.coll_date
 where unit_id = szUnitId and coll_date = :ctrl_block_1.colldate;
 
 update TEST_BAND_DETAIL set coll_date = :donations.coll_date
 where unit_id = szUnitId and coll_date = :ctrl_block_1.colldate;

 update TEST_BAND_HEADER set coll_date = :donations.coll_date
 where unit_id = szUnitId and coll_date=:ctrl_block_1.colldate;

 update UNIT_TEST_RESULTS set coll_date = :donations.coll_date
 where unit_id = szUnitId and coll_date=:ctrl_block_1.colldate;

 Exception
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 HANDLE_ERROR;
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 End;

 go_item('donations.s_pass_unit_id');
 hide_window('window_coll');

 End if;


 /************* Donation attributes => Venipuncture and Rections *********************/
 Begin

 -- first clean up the existing veni code if available 

 If :donations.S_venipuncture is not null and :GLOBAL.s_venipuncture is not null then
 Delete donation_attributes where transaction_id = :donations.transaction_id;
 End if;

 /* Let us say there is only one Veni code and you want to remove the one through this program,
 then the above 'if' satement will not work so I have to add another 'if' statement to
 handle this condition TT 001.012711 : Edwin 10.01.01
 */

 If :donations.S_venipuncture is null and :GLOBAL.s_venipuncture is not null then
 Delete donation_attributes where transaction_id = :donations.transaction_id;
 End if;

 -- clean up over
 -- Add new veni codes

 If :donations.S_venipuncture is not null then 

 FOR cnt IN 1..99 loop
 if str_cnt > NVL(length(:donations.S_venipuncture), 0) then
 exit;
 end if;

 insert into donation_attributes(transaction_ID, ATTRIB_CODE, PROGRAM_ID,chapter_id,ATTRIB_VALUE )
 values (:donations.transaction_id,'VENI',:banner.prog_name,:global.chapter_id,
 substr(:donations.S_venipuncture,str_cnt,2));
 str_cnt := str_cnt + 3;
 END LOOP;

 End if;

 :GLOBAL.s_venipuncture:=null;
 Exception
 when others then
 SHOW_ERROR('16012');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE; 
end;

/******************** rections ******************/

--Modified on 04/29/08 By Edwin 3.3.0 release
IF :donations.S_rections is not null then
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nReact from donation_attributes where
 transaction_id=:donations.transaction_id and attrib_code='REACT';

 If nReact = 0 then 
 insert into donation_attributes(transaction_ID, ATTRIB_CODE, PROGRAM_ID,chapter_id,ATTRIB_VALUE)
 values (:donations.transaction_id,'REACT',:banner.prog_name,:global.chapter_id,:donations.S_rections);
 Else
 update donation_attributes set attrib_value=:donations.s_rections where
 transaction_id=:donations.transaction_id and attrib_code='REACT';
 End if; 
 
END IF;


END;

PROCEDURE place_donor_holds(h_donor_id in varchar2,int_code in varchar2,h_def_thru_date in date,
 pl_out out varchar2) IS

BEGIN

 /* If a hold had been placed already , it will not be placed again */

 transaction_id=:donations.transaction_id and donor_id=h_donor_id and

 IF v_count =0 then

 v_date:=h_def_thru_date;
 
 don_inter.inter_upgrade_place(h_donor_id,:global.chapter_id,szUnitId,
 :donations.transaction_id,int_code,NULL,NULL,:banner.user_id,
 NULL,NULL,:banner.prog_name,:ctrl_block_1.drive_date,v_date,null,donor_status);

 if donor_status != 'OK' then
 pl_out:=donor_status;
 else
 pl_out:='OK';
 end if;
 
 ELSE

 END IF;
 
EXCEPTION

 when others then
 pl_out:=sqlerrm;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_STICK_TIME
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION check_stick_time ( b_time1 in date, b_time2 in date )RETURN boolean IS
 a date;
 b date;
BEGIN
 a := to_date(to_char(:ctrl_block_1.drive_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')||' '||to_char(b_time1,'hh24:mi'),'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi');
 b := to_date(to_char(:ctrl_block_1.drive_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')||' '||to_char(b_time2,'hh24:mi'),'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi');
 
 if a >= b THEN
 return false;
 else
 return TRUE;
 end if;

ProgramUnit.Name: PLACE_DONATION_HOLDS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE place_donation_holds(int_code in varchar2 ) IS
 inter_found varchar2(1) := 'N';
 v_screen_unit_id varchar2(15);
BEGIN
 :global.temp := :system.cursor_item;
 GO_BLOCK('DONATION_INTERDICTIONS');
 GO_RECORD(1);

 GET_FINAL_UNIT(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id,v_screen_unit_id);

 IF :INTER_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN
 Loop
 If :DONATION_INTERDICTIONS.INTER_CODE = INT_CODE THEN
 inter_found := 'F';
 :donation_interdictions.release_user:=null;
 :donation_interdictions.release_date:=null;
 :donation_interdictions.term_date:=null;
 :donation_interdictions.s_status:=null;
 EXIT;
 End if;

 If :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE' THEN
 Exit;
 Else
 NEXT_RECORD;
 End if;
 End loop;
 ELSE
 select inter_desc into :donation_interdictions.comments from valid_interdictions
 where inter_code = int_code and inter_type = 'HOLDS'; 

 :donation_interdictions.inter_code := int_code;
 :donation_interdictions.check := int_code;
 :donation_interdictions.unit_id := v_screen_unit_id;
 inter_found := 'F';
 END IF;

 IF inter_found = 'N' then

 If :INTER_CODE IS NULL THEN
 select inter_desc into :donation_interdictions.comments from 
 valid_interdictions where inter_code = int_code and inter_type = 'HOLDS'; 

 :donation_interdictions.inter_code := int_code;
 :donation_interdictions.check := int_code;
 :donation_interdictions.unit_id := v_screen_unit_id;
 Else
 NEXT_RECORD;
 select inter_desc into :donation_interdictions.comments
 from valid_interdictions
 where inter_code = int_code and inter_type = 'HOLDS'; 

 :donation_interdictions.inter_code := int_code;
 :donation_interdictions.check := int_code;
 :donation_interdictions.unit_id := v_screen_unit_id;
 End if;
 GO_ITEM(:GLOBAL.TEMP);
 ELSE
 GO_ITEM(:GLOBAL.TEMP);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 when No_data_found then
 message('Contact IS');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
END;

PROCEDURE compu_term_date(pl_hold_code in varchar2,pl_incident_date in date,
 pl_term_date out date) IS

 v_fixed_period VARCHAR2(2);
 v_period_type VARCHAR2(8);
 v_period_number NUMBER:=0;
 v_minimum_period NUMBER:=0;
 v_term_date DATE;
 v_status VARCHAR2(200);

BEGIN
 select fixed_period,period_type,period_number,minimum_period into

EXCEPTION

 check_package_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_DONATION_INTERDICTIONS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE update_donation_interdictions(szUnitId in varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 If :ctrl_block_1.colldate!=:donations.coll_date then
 Update donation_interdictions set coll_date =:donations.coll_date 
 where unit_id =szUnitId and coll_date= :ctrl_block_1.colldate;
 End if;
 
 
 
 If :donations.procedure_code<>'99' then 
 update donation_interdictionS set release_date=sysdate, release_user=:banner.user_id, term_date=sysdate where
 transaction_id=:donations.transaction_id and inter_code in (select inter_code from valid_regint_reasons where
 inter_reason='NOPROCEDUR');
 End If;
 
 If :donations.donation_type<>'99' then 
 update donation_interdictionS set release_date=sysdate, release_user=:banner.user_id, term_date=sysdate where
 transaction_id=:donations.transaction_id and inter_code in (select inter_code from valid_regint_reasons where
 inter_reason='NODONATION');
 End If;
 
 If :donations.physical_id is not null and :donations.physical_id <>'99' then 
 update donation_interdictionS set release_date=sysdate, release_user=:banner.user_id, term_date=sysdate where
 transaction_id=:donations.transaction_id and inter_code in (select inter_code from valid_regint_reasons where
 inter_reason='NOPHYSICAL');
 End If;
 
 
 If :donations.screener_id is not null and :donations.screener_id not in ('99','88') then 
 update donation_interdictionS set release_date=sysdate, release_user=:banner.user_id, term_date=sysdate where
 transaction_id=:donations.transaction_id and inter_code in (select inter_code from valid_regint_reasons where
 inter_reason='NOSCREENER');
 End If;
 
 
 If :donations.first_reviewer_id is not null and :donations.first_reviewer_id not in ('99') then 
 update donation_interdictionS set release_date=sysdate, release_user=:banner.user_id, term_date=sysdate where
 transaction_id=:donations.transaction_id and inter_code in (select inter_code from valid_regint_reasons where
 inter_reason='NOREVIEW');
 End If;
 
 
 
 
 
 
Exception when others then
 message('Err-100'||sqlerrm);
 check_package_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_DDI_DDT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE update_ddi_ddt IS

 v_out VARCHAR2(200);
 place_except EXCEPTION;
 remove_except EXCEPTION;

 Function check_for_inter(pl_inter in varchar2) return boolean is
 v_count number:=0;
 Begin
 select nvl(count(*),0) into v_count from donor_interdictions where
 donor_id = :donations.donor_id and transaction_id = :donations.transaction_id and 
 inter_code=pl_inter and term_date is null;
 if v_count > 0 then 
 return TRUE;
 else
 return FALSE;
 end if;
 End;
 
BEGIN

IF :global.remove_inter='Y' and
 :donations.deferral_reason='0' THEN
 
 If check_for_inter('DDI') then
 remove_donor_holds(:donations.donor_id,:donations.transaction_id,'DDI',v_out);
 if v_out!='OK' then 
 raise remove_except;
 end if;
 End if;

 If check_for_inter('DDT') then
 remove_donor_holds(:donations.donor_id,:donations.transaction_id,'DDT',v_out);
 if v_out!='OK' then 
 raise remove_except;
 end if;
 End if;

ELSIF :global.remove_inter='Y' and
 :donations.deferral_reason!='0' THEN
 
 -- case:1 update NA to IND

 If :global.deferral_type='NA' and :donations.deferral_type='IND' then 
 place_donor_holds(:donations.donor_id,'DDI',:donations.deferred_thru_date,v_out);
 if v_out!='OK' then 
 raise place_except;
 end if;
 End if;
 
 -- case:2 update IND to null or NA or '99'

 If :global.deferral_type='IND' and 
 (:donations.deferral_type='NA' or
 :donations.deferral_type is null or
 :donations.deferral_type='99') then

 remove_donor_holds(:donations.donor_id,:donations.transaction_id,'DDI',v_out);
 if v_out!='OK' then 
 raise remove_except;
 end if; 
 End if;

 If :global.deferral_type='99' and :donations.deferral_type='IND' then 
 place_donor_holds(:donations.donor_id,'DDI',:donations.deferred_thru_date,v_out);
 if v_out!='OK' then 
 raise place_except;
 end if;
 End if;

 -- case:3 update only the date
 -- 3.a Adding a new date
 
 If :global.dftd is null Then --global if 
 if :donations.deferred_thru_date is not null then
 if :donations.deferred_thru_date > :donations.coll_date then
 place_donor_holds(:donations.donor_id,'DDT',:donations.deferred_thru_date,v_out);
 if v_out!='OK' then 
 raise place_except;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 
 Else -- 3.b Modifying the date (:global.dftd is not null) global elsif 
 
 If :donations.deferred_thru_date is not null then
 If :global.dftd <> :donations.deferred_thru_date then
 remove_donor_holds(:donations.donor_id,:donations.transaction_id,'DDT',v_out);
 if v_out!='OK' then 
 raise remove_except;
 end if;
 if :donations.deferred_thru_date > :donations.coll_date Then
 place_donor_holds(:donations.donor_id,'DDT',:donations.deferred_thru_date,v_out);
 if v_out!='OK' then 
 raise place_except;
 end if; 
 end if;
 end if;
 End if;

 If :donations.deferred_thru_date is null then
 remove_donor_holds(:donations.donor_id,:donations.transaction_id,'DDT',v_out);
 if v_out!='OK' then 
 raise remove_except;
 end if; 
 
 if :donations.deferral_type='IND' then 
 place_donor_holds(:donations.donor_id,'DDI',:donations.deferred_thru_date,v_out);
 if v_out!='OK' then 
 raise place_except;
 end if; 
 end if;

 End if;

 End if; --global end if 

 
 ELSIF :global.remove_inter='N' THEN
 If :donations.donor_id is not null and :donations.deferral_type='IND' then
 place_donor_holds(:donations.donor_id,'DDI',null,v_out);
 if v_out!='OK' then 
 raise place_except;
 end if; 
 End if;

 If :donations.donor_id is not null and :donations.deferred_thru_date is not null then
 if :donations.deferred_thru_date > :donations.coll_date then
 place_donor_holds(:donations.donor_id,'DDT',:donations.deferred_thru_date,v_out);
 if v_out!='OK' then 
 raise place_except;
 end if; 
 end if;
 End if;
 
 END IF;

Exception
 
 when remove_except then
 clear_form(no_validate);
 show_error('16112');
 check_package_failure;

 when place_except then
 clear_form(no_validate);
 show_error('16113');
 check_package_failure;

 when others then
 message(sqlerrm);
 check_package_failure;
End;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_VOID_UNIT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_void_unit(pl_void_unit in varchar2) IS
 temp_v_unit_id varchar2(15) := pl_void_unit;
 temp_v_out_unit_id varchar2(15) := null;
 temp_v_out_chk_digit varchar2(2) := null; 
BEGIN

 IF Length(pl_void_unit)=7 then
 Validate_Unit_Scan_Codabar(temp_v_unit_id,'M','C',temp_v_out_unit_id);
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_v_out_unit_id;
 ELSE
 Validate_unit_scan_Code128(temp_v_unit_id,'M','I',temp_v_out_unit_id,temp_v_out_chk_digit); 
 
 -- I understood that if the entered check digit is correct, then it will return '-*' that is why
 -- the following check is written
 -- Edwin 04-20-2001

 IF temp_v_out_chk_digit = '-*' THEN
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := temp_v_out_chk_digit;
 -- :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := substr(temp_v_unit_id,1,13); by Edwin 

 ELSE
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF; 
END;

PROCEDURE donor_eligibility(szTmpUnitId in varchar2) IS -- IM 10109; Copied from DRIREGIS.
 elig_status varchar(1);
 deff_date date;
 int_type varchar(10);
 P_reason varchar(50);
 tr_id varchar(10);
 UN_id varchar(15);
 sts varchar(300);
 C_DATE DATE;
 v_out VARCHAR2(2000);
 remove_except EXCEPTION;
 
BEGIN

-- Added by Edwin on 03/15/2001 to incorporat the ISBT 

 
 don_core.check_eligibility(:donors.donor_id,:donations.procedure_code,:donations.donation_type,
 --:ctrl_block_1.colldate -1 , -- IM 10109 ; this has to be one day before, as this counts current donation and gives "attempt to donate too soon"
 :ctrl_block_1.colldate, -- IM 10387; 
 :donors.donor_weight,elig_status ,deff_date,int_type,P_reason );

 -- IM 10387 -- 02/18/2015
 -- added the below eligibility check by passing coll_date -1 . This check is run only for scenarios where "donate too soon" is returned. TO make sure that donor is attempting
 -- to donate too soon, we pass coll_date -1 and see if we still receive the same error. 
 if elig_status = 'N' and INSTR(p_reason, 'donate too soon') > 0 then
 -- added on 02/18/2015;
 don_core.check_eligibility(:donors.donor_id,:donations.procedure_code,:donations.donation_type,
 :ctrl_block_1.colldate-1, -- IM 10387; this has to be one day before, as this counts current donation and gives "attempt to donate too soon"
 :donors.donor_weight,elig_status ,deff_date,int_type,P_reason ); 
 end if; 

 if elig_status = 'N' then
 Place_donation_holds('DNELG');
 GLOBALVAR.elig_def_thru_date:=to_char(deff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy');
 else
 v_out := NULL;
 remove_dnelg_holds(pl_unit_id => szTmpUnitId, 
 pl_coll_date => :ctrl_block_1.colldate,
 pl_transaction_id => :donations.transaction_id,
 pl_out => v_out); -- IM 10109 -- Added on 10/02/2014;
 if v_out!='OK' then 
 raise remove_except;
 end if;
 end if; 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN remove_except then
 item_change('donations.s_pass_unit_id','E');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id','E');
 :donations.s_pass_unit_id:=null;
 :donations.f_pass_unit_id:=null;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id:=null;
 clear_form(no_validate);
 show_error('16112');
 check_package_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: REMOVE_DNELG_HOLDS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE remove_dnelg_holds(pl_unit_id in varchar2, pl_coll_date in date,pl_transaction_id in varchar2,
 pl_out out varchar2) IS


 CURSOR doni_cur IS
 SELECT dri.transaction_id, dri.unit_id, dri.inter_code, dri.source_code,
 dri.originated_from, dri.reason_code, dri.group_id, dri.group_mode, 
 dri.insert_date, dri.term_date
 FROM donation_interdictions dri
 WHERE dri.release_date IS NULL
 AND (dri.term_date is null or dri.term_date > pl_coll_date)
 AND dri.transaction_id = pl_transaction_id
 AND dri.inter_code = 'DNELG';

 v_status varchar2(200);
 chp_sysdate DATE;
BEGIN
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 end;
 FOR doni_rec IN doni_cur LOOP
/* 
 don_inter.remove_inter_unit(pl_unit_id,null,pl_coll_date,:global.chapter_id,pl_transaction_id,
 pl_inter_code,null,null,null,LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,null,null,:banner.prog_name,
 null,sysdate,'MISTA',v_status);
*/ 
 don_inter.remove_inter_unit(
 p_unit_id => pl_unit_id,
 p_deferral_id => NULL,
 p_coll_date => pl_coll_date,
 p_chapter_id => :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID,
 p_transaction_id => pl_transaction_id,
 p_inter_code => 'DNELG',
 p_originated_from => doni_rec.originated_from,
 p_reason_code => doni_rec.reason_code,
 p_source_code => doni_rec.source_code,
 p_user_id => lt_user_session.get_userid,
 p_group_mode => doni_rec.group_mode,
 p_group_id => doni_rec.group_id,
 p_program_id => :BANNER.PROG_NAME,
 p_incident_date => NULL,
 p_term_date => chp_sysdate,
 p_term_reason => 'NOPRO',
 p_status => v_status );
 if v_status!='OK' then
 pl_out:=v_status;
 else
 pl_out:=v_status;
 end if;
 END LOOP;
EXCEPTION when others then
 pl_out:=sqlerrm;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: BLEED_END_TIME_KNI
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE BLEED_END_TIME_KNI (bleed_end_time_in IN DATE, arm_code_in IN VARCHAR2)IS
 temp VARCHAR2(5);
 alert_id ALERT;
 alert_button NUMBER;
 alert_msg VARCHAR2(100):= 'Possible illogical bleed time - Place hold ?';
 start_time NUMBER;
 end_time NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SYNCHRONIZE;
 :Global.Error_count :='N';
 IF bleed_end_time_in IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF NOT(check_bleed_time(:donations.b_start_date, bleed_end_time_in )) THEN -- SCR 12040 
 show_error('16068');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 IF arm_code_in = 'L1' THEN
 start_time:=to_number(TO_CHAR(:donations.bleed_start_time_L1,'hh24mi'));
 ELSIF arm_code_in = 'L2' THEN
 start_time:=to_number(TO_CHAR(:donations.bleed_start_time_L2,'hh24mi')); 
 ELSIF arm_code_in = 'R1' THEN
 start_time:=to_number(TO_CHAR(:donations.bleed_start_time_R1,'hh24mi'));
 ELSIF arm_code_in = 'R2' THEN
 start_time:=to_number(TO_CHAR(:donations.bleed_start_time_R2,'hh24mi')); 
 ELSIF arm_code_in = 'O' THEN
 start_time:=to_number(TO_CHAR(:donations.other_bleed_s_time,'hh24mi')); 
 END IF;
 
 end_time:=to_number(TO_CHAR(bleed_end_time_in,'hh24mi'));
 
 IF end_time < start_time THEN
 alert_id := Find_Alert('YES_OR_NO');
 Set_Alert_Property(alert_id, alert_message_text, alert_msg);
 alert_button := Show_Alert( alert_id );
 IF alert_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 SELECT NVL(inter_code,'***') INTO temp
 FROM VALID_REGINT_REASONS
 WHERE inter_reason = 'ILIGLBLEED';
 IF temp != '***' THEN
 place_donation_holds(temp);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 NULL;
 END IF;
 :donations.b_end_date := :donations.b_start_date +1;
 next_item;
 ELSE
 SELECT NVL(inter_code,'***') INTO temp
 FROM VALID_REGINT_REASONS
 WHERE inter_reason = 'ILIGLBLEED';
 IF temp != '***' THEN
 REMOVE_HOLDS(TEMP);
 END IF;
 next_item;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 next_item;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
WHEN value_error THEN
 NULL;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: BLEED_START_TIME_KNI
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE bleed_start_time_kni (bleed_start_time_in IN DATE, arm_code_in IN VARCHAR2)IS
 d_drive_start_dt DATE; -- SCR 12040
 d_drive_end_dt DATE; -- SCR 12040
 d_local_drive_start_dt DATE; -- SCR 12040
 d_local_drive_end_dt DATE; -- SCR 12040
 v_bleed_start_dt VARCHAR2(18); -- SCR 12040
 d_bleed_start_dt date; -- SCR 12040
 v_allowed_drive_date VARCHAR2(18);
 v_mid_night_crossing VARCHAR2(2);
 err_txt VARCHAR2(300):= 'Bleed start time inconsistant with drive date - Should collection date be set to forward/backward?';
 alert_id Alert;
 alert_button NUMBER;
BEGIN
 :Global.Error_count :='N';
 IF bleed_start_time_in IS NOT NULL THEN 
 IF NOT(check_bleed_time(:donations.b_start_date, bleed_start_time_in )) THEN -- SCR 12040 
 show_error('16068');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 -- Below is for L2 and R2 specific only.......
 IF arm_code_in = 'L2' THEN
 IF not(check_stick_time(:donations.bleed_start_time_L1,:donations.bleed_start_time_L2)) then
 show_error('16069');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 ELSIF arm_code_in = 'R2' THEN 
 IF not(check_stick_time(:donations.bleed_start_time_R1,:donations.bleed_start_time_R2)) then
 show_error('16069');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 END IF;
 -------------
 
 /******** Check the actual/scheduled start time if the drive * **************/ 
 -- SCR 12040
 SELECT NVL(actual_start_time,schedule_start_time), NVL(actual_end_time, schedule_end_time)INTO d_drive_start_dt, d_drive_end_dt
 FROM drives
 WHERE drive_id = :ctrl_block_1.drive_id
 AND chapter_id =:global.chapter_id;
 ----
 
 -- SCR 12040
 IF is_timezone_enabled THEN
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,d_drive_start_dt, d_local_drive_start_dt);
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,d_drive_end_dt, d_local_drive_end_dt);
 ELSE
 d_local_drive_start_dt := d_drive_start_dt;
 d_local_drive_end_dt := d_drive_end_dt;
 END IF;
 
 
 -- SCR 12040
 v_bleed_start_dt := TO_CHAR(:donations.b_start_date,'mm-dd-yy') ||' '|| TO_CHAR(bleed_start_time_in,'HH24:mi');
 d_bleed_start_dt := TO_DATE( v_bleed_start_dt, 'mm-dd-yy hh24:mi');
 ---
 
 IF d_bleed_start_dt NOT BETWEEN d_local_drive_start_dt AND d_local_drive_end_dt THEN -- SCR 12040
 alert_id := Find_Alert('YES_NO');
 Set_Alert_Property(alert_id, alert_message_text, err_txt );
 alert_button := Show_Alert( alert_id );
 -- SCR 12040
 IF alert_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 IF d_bleed_start_dt+1 >= LIFETRACK_TIMEZONE_CONVERT.GET_LOCAL_TIME(:GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID, SYSDATE) THEN
 show_error('16166');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 :donations.b_start_date := :donations.b_start_date +1;
 :donations.b_end_date := :donations.b_start_date;
 next_item;
 END IF;
 END IF; 
 --

 IF alert_button = ALERT_BUTTON2 THEN
 :donations.b_start_date := :donations.b_start_date -1;
 :donations.b_end_date := :donations.b_start_date;
 next_item;
 END IF;
 IF alert_button = ALERT_BUTTON3 THEN
 next_item;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 :donations.b_start_date := :ctrl_block_1.drive_date;
 :donations.b_end_date := :donations.b_start_date;
 next_item;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 :donations.b_end_date := :donations.b_start_date;
 next_item;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
WHEN value_error THEN
 MESSAGE(sqlerrm);
 check_package_failure;
WHEN OTHERS THEN
 MESSAGE(sqlerrm);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_BLEED_TIME
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION check_bleed_time (date_in IN DATE, time_in IN DATE )RETURN boolean IS
/* added this function for SCR 12040 */
 l_sysdate_dt DATE;
 l_bleed_dt DATE;
BEGIN
 IF is_timezone_enabled THEN
 l_sysdate_dt := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,SYSDATE); 
 ELSE
 l_sysdate_dt := SYSDATE;
 END IF;

 l_bleed_dt := TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(date_in, 'MM-DD-YYYY') || ' ' || TO_CHAR(time_in, 'HH24:MI'), 'MM-DD-YYYY HH24:MI');
 
 -- IF entered date is greater than SYSDATE (local or gmt)
 IF l_bleed_dt >= l_sysdate_dt THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 ELSE
 RETURN TRUE;
 END IF;
 
END;

procedure validate_area_code(p_areaCode IN VARCHAR2) is -- MLT 1936
 chk_cnt number;
 chp_sysdate date;
begin
 if p_areaCode is not null then
 --
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,
 sysdate,
 chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 -- 
 
 select count(*)
 into chk_cnt
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'AREAC'
 and code = p_areaCode
 and chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, chp_sysdate + 1);

 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end validate_area_code;

procedure set_preferred_contact_flag is -- MLT 1936
begin
 if :donor_addresses.s_m_preferred = 'Y' then
 :donor_addresses.preferred_contact_flag := 'M';
 elsif :donor_addresses.s_w_preferred = 'Y' then
 :donor_addresses.preferred_contact_flag := 'W';
 elsif :donor_addresses.s_h_preferred = 'Y' then
 :donor_addresses.preferred_contact_flag := 'H';
 else
 :donor_addresses.preferred_contact_flag := NULL;
 end if;
end;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_EMPLOYERS
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select 
a.employer_name, 
a.employer_id, 
decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N'), 'Y', a.intl_postal_code, b.zip) ZIP, 
decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N'), 'Y', a.intl_city, b.city) CITY, 
decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N'), 'Y', a.intl_state, b.state) STATE,
decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N'), 'Y', a.intl_country_name, 'USA') COUNTRY,
a.usps_id 
from donor_employers a , valid_city_state b 
where a.usps_id = b.usps_id 
and employer_name like '%'||:donor_addresses.employer_name||'%' 
and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate)+1) 
and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
order by 1,4,3
