RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select distinct code, description 
from valid_master_codes
where code_type = 'CNTRY' 
and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1)

RecordGroup.Name: RG_REACTIONS
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select code,description from valid_master_codes where code_type = 'REACT' and term_date is null

RecordGroup.Name: RG_SPONSORS
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select name, sponsor_id from sponsors where name like '%'||:donations.credit_sponsor||'%' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) 
and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id order by substr(sponsor_id,5,6)

RecordGroup.Name: RG_VENI
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select attrib_code, attrib_desc from valid_attributes_don where attrib_group= 'VENI' and instr(nvl(:donations.s_venipuncture,'*'), attrib_code,1) = 0 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)

RecordGroup.Name: RG_DRIVES
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select to_char(c.drive_date,'MMDDYYYY') d_date, a.drive_id, b.name from drive_sponsors a , sponsors b, drives c where c.drive_date = nvl(:ctrl_block_1.drive_date,sysdate) and a.sponsor_id = b.sponsor_id and a.drive_id = c.drive_id

RecordGroup.Name: RG_ETHNIC
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select code, description from valid_master_codes where code_type = 'ETHGP' and term_date is null order by 1

RecordGroup.Name: RG_HOLDS
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select inter_code ,inter_desc ,inter_type from valid_interdictions where inter_type = 'HOLDS' and Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) between eff_date and nvl(term_date,Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate)+1) and manual_hold_flag='Y'

RecordGroup.Name: RG_DONATION_TYPES
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select distinct a.donation_type,b.description, b.sort_sequence from valid_donproc_codes a,valid_donation_types b where a.donation_type = b.donation_type and b.term_date is null order by b.sort_sequence

RecordGroup.Name: RG_PROC_CODES
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select distinct a.procedure_code, b.description, b.sort_sequence
 from valid_donproc_codes a, valid_proc_codes b
 where a.procedure_code = b.procedure_code
 and a.donation_type = :donations.donation_type
 and :ctrl_block_1.chp_sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date, :ctrl_block_1.chp_sysdate + 1)
 order by b.sort_sequence

RecordGroup.Name: RG_COLL_DATE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select coll_date from donations where unit_id=:f_unit_id

RecordGroup.Name: RG_PHLEBO
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select distinct a.staff_no,a.Last_name|| ', '||a.first_name name from employees a where :ctrl_block_1.drive_date between a.eff_date and
nvl(a.term_date,sysdate+1) and a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id

RecordGroup.Name: RG_ZIPS
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select zip , city ,state,usps_id from valid_city_state where (city = :donor_addresses.city)

RecordGroup.Name: RG_E_ZIP
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select zip , city ,state,usps_id from valid_city_state where (city = :donor_addresses.e_city)

RecordGroup.Name: RG_CITY
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select city ,state, zip usps_id from valid_city_state where city like :donor_addresses.city||'%' order by 1

RecordGroup.Name: RG_E_CITY
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select city ,state, zip usps_id from valid_city_state where city like :donor_addresses.e_city||'%' order by 1

RecordGroup.Name: RG_ALTID
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select code,description from valid_master_codes where
code_type='ALTID' and sysdate between eff_date and
nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)

DECLARE
 l_chp_id VARCHAR2(4);
 l_print_id VARCHAR2(40);
 l_error VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN
 populate_chapter_ID(l_chp_id, l_print_id, l_error);
 IF l_error IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF l_error in ('9776','9777') THEN
 show_error(l_error); -- Message Type
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));
 pause;
 END IF; 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;

declare
 msg number;
begin
 select count(msg_id)
 into msg
 from alert_log
 where user_id = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid
 and read_date is null;
 
 if msg > 0 then
 set_item_property('toolbar.pb_alerts',label,'Msg: '||to_char(msg));
 end if;
exception
 when program_error then
 null; 
end;
